Why Sports

My Story

Sports have always been at the forefront of my life. Some of my earliest memories center around Saturday Night Football games watching my father’s Texas Longhorns duke it out against their Big 12 rivals. For me, games offered not only a momentary escape from the troubles of everyday life, but a sense of unity that never ceased to bring family and friends together. As a goalkeeper for my club soccer team, the soccer pitch became a source of personal pride where I controlled destiny and it felt like every success and failure rested on me. As Teddy Roosevelt put it, I wanted to be “The Man in the Arena,” shouldering my own individual responsibilities for the betterment of the team around me.

I have always believed that nothing brings people together like their love and passion for a team, and even in the bleakest of defeats, I often feel nothing but gratitude for the opportunity to come together with the people I love. Ultimately, I want to spend my career creating the moments that make people feel, if only for a few hours, that they are part of something bigger than themselves.
